_doc: Director copy (tt-02, owner request 2026-10-25, continues tt-01). Every panel in a card's focus tooltip stack is the term's title plus ONE short sentence. tt-01 shortened the glossary; this file covers the card-specific text that action_icon_library.gd builds in code and that bypasses the glossary. 'current' is the text one card shows today (numbers as on that card); {n}, {r} are the card's own values. 'text': null means 'show the glossary sentence for this term'. 'grimoire' is detail cut from the tooltip that must survive in the named term's Grimoire entry (append it there if no paragraph already says it).
rules: R1 One panel = title + one sentence. The body never contains a line break, a second sentence, or a sub-heading line (e.g. 'Area pattern', 'Next Attack', 'Cleanse', 'Meteorfall', 'If Target Frozen', 'Each Enemy in Light'). Modifier lines ('Modified by:') are unchanged.
R2 A card-specific sentence REPLACES the glossary sentence; never show both.

R3 Ground panels (Fire, Ice, Electrified, Rubble) show only the glossary sentence; placement lines ('Leaves this ground ...') are dropped because the card face already shows where. Exception: the Ice panel on a card that converts Ice to Electrified (row ice_to_electrified).

R4 No sentence appears twice in one card's stack. When two panels would say the same thing, the panel for the term the sentence is about keeps it and the other shows its glossary sentence (rows next_attack_pierce, next_attack_chain, block_to_stoneskin).
R5 On a Cleanse card, the listed statuses get no panels of their own; the single Cleanse panel names them.
R6 A panel title is always a term name (at most 4 words), never a sentence. Rows title_sentence_* fix the panels whose whole sentence currently renders as the title with an empty body.
R7 One stack holds at most one panel per term id unless the texts differ after these rules (e.g. two Range panels for different targets stay).

rows.title: Petrify
rows.current: The enemy turns to stone: it skips its next turn (the skipped turn still costs its Time) and gains {n} Block, which lasts through your next turn. Dragons are immune.
rows.text: Skips its next turn and gains {n} Block.
rows.grimoire: petrify: the skipped turn still costs its Time; the Block lasts through your next turn; dragons are immune.

rows.title: Detonate
rows.current: When the keg is destroyed by anything, it deals {n} to its tile and each tile next to it: you, illusions, enemies and terrain. Kegs set each other off.
rows.text: When destroyed, the keg deals {n} to everything on and next to it.
rows.grimoire: detonate: this includes you, illusions, enemies and terrain; kegs set each other off.

rows.title: Cinder Marks
rows.current: Meteorfall\nMarks the shown tiles. At the start of your next turn, before you draw, each marked tile takes the damage (anyone there, including you) and becomes Fire.
rows.text: At your next turn, the marked tiles take the damage, you included, and turn to Fire.
rows.grimoire: cinder_marks: it lands at the start of your next turn, before you draw.

rows.title: Raise Terrain
rows.current: Raises a Worldspine with this much health on each empty tile around the target. Spires block movement, not sight, and leave Rubble when destroyed.
rows.text: Raises a Worldspine with this much Health on each empty tile around the target.
rows.grimoire: raise_terrain: Worldspines block movement, not sight, and leave Rubble when destroyed.

rows.title: Raise Terrain
rows.current: Raises an outcrop with this much health on empty floor. It blocks movement and sight and leaves Rubble when destroyed.
rows.text: Raises an outcrop with this much Health that blocks movement and sight.
rows.grimoire: raise_terrain: outcrops leave Rubble when destroyed.

rows.title: Raise Terrain
rows.current: Places a powder keg with this much health on empty floor. It blocks movement, not sight.
rows.text: Places a powder keg with this much Health that blocks movement, not sight.

rows.title: Crystal Mantle
rows.current: Each direct hit against you breaks one layer instead of dealing damage. Fire, Bleed, collisions, traps and health costs bypass it.
rows.grimoire: frost_armor: Fire, Bleed, collisions, traps and Health costs bypass it.

rows.title: (ground name)
rows.current: <glossary sentence>\nLeaves this ground in the affected area. | ... on each tile you leave. | ... under each adjacent enemy. | ... on each detonated tile and its four neighbors. | ... on each tile the target passes through. | Each marked tile becomes this ground when the meteor lands. | ... on the tile you started on. | ... on each empty tile next to the illusion. | ... under each adjacent enemy and on your tile. | Detonates this ground instead of Fire.

rows.title: Ice
rows.current: Units on it are Chilled.\nTurns a Ice tile and every Ice tile connected to it into Electrified.
rows.text: The chosen Ice and all Ice connected to it become Electrified.
rows.note: On this card the Electrified panel shows its glossary sentence.

rows.title: Light
rows.current: Each Enemy in Light\nHits every enemy you can see that stands in Light. There is no target to choose.
rows.text: Only enemies standing in Light are hit.

rows.title: Fire
rows.current: Each Enemy on Fire\nHits every enemy you can see that stands on Fire. There is no target to choose.
rows.text: Only enemies standing on Fire are hit.

rows.title: Chilled
rows.current: Each Chilled Enemy\nHits every Chilled enemy you can see. There is no target to choose.
rows.text: Only Chilled enemies are hit.

rows.title: Electrified
rows.current: Each Enemy on Electrified\nHits every enemy you can see that stands on Electrified ground. There is no target to choose.
rows.text: Only enemies standing on Electrified ground are hit.

rows.title: Shatter
rows.current: Shatter\nIf the target was Frozen before the hit, deal {n} to each other enemy next to it (not tripled).
rows.text: If the target was Frozen, deal {n} to each enemy next to it.
rows.grimoire: freeze: Shatter checks Freeze before the hit, and its splash damage is not tripled.

rows.title: Terrain Burst
rows.current: At the start of each of your turns, each enemy next to at least one of your Worldspines takes {n}.
rows.text: Each turn, enemies next to your Worldspines take {n}.
rows.grimoire: terrain_burst: it happens at the start of each of your turns, once per enemy however many spires touch it.

rows.title: Terrain Burst
rows.current: Destroy an outcrop, crate or other terrain within range and sight.
rows.text: Destroy an outcrop, crate or other terrain in range and sight.

rows.title: Terrain Burst
rows.current: Destroy an adjacent Outcrop or Worldspine you raised.
rows.text: Destroy an adjacent outcrop or Worldspine you raised.

rows.title: If at Half Health
rows.current: If Target at Half Health\nApplies if the target is at or below half health before the hit.
rows.text: This bonus applies if the target is at or below half Health.

rows.title: If Frozen
rows.current: If Target Frozen\nApplies if the target is Frozen before the hit.
rows.text: This bonus applies if the target is Frozen.

rows.title: If in Light
rows.current: If Target in Light\nApplies if the target stands in Light.
rows.text: This bonus applies if the target stands in Light.

rows.title: Swap Illusion
rows.current: Swap places with one of your illusions. Both of you trigger the ground and traps where you land.
rows.grimoire: illusion_swap: both of you trigger the ground and traps where you land.

rows.title: Swap
rows.current: Swap places with a one-tile enemy or one of your illusions. Both arrive normally; nothing collides.
rows.grimoire: swap: only one-tile enemies; both arrive normally and nothing collides.

rows.title: Shatter Illusion
rows.current: Destroy one of your illusions within range. It counts as destroyed for illusion effects.
rows.grimoire: shatter_illusion: it counts as destroyed for illusion effects.

rows.title: Block
rows.current: The illusion gains all your Block as extra health. You lose that Block.
rows.text: Your illusion takes all your Block as extra Health.

rows.title: Retaliate
rows.current: Enemies that damage this illusion take {n} Lightning damage and are Shocked. Once per enemy attack.
rows.text: Enemies that damage this illusion take {n} Lightning damage and are Shocked.
rows.grimoire: retaliate: an illusion's Retaliate triggers once per enemy attack.

rows.title: Skate
rows.current: This turn, moving onto Ice costs no movement and Ice doesn't Chill you.

rows.title: Empower
rows.current: Optional: pay the extra cost while playing this card for the bonus.

rows.title: Follow-up
rows.current: Gains this bonus if you already played a card this turn.

rows.current: The chosen enemy is Exposed {n}.

rows.title: Fireproof
rows.current: Fire doesn't damage you this turn.

rows.current: Deals 1 more damage for each tile you moved this turn (maximum {n} more).
rows.text: Deals 1 more for each tile you moved this turn, up to {n} more.

rows.title: Next Attack

rows.text: Your next attack this turn deals 1 more per tile you moved, up to {n} more.

rows.text: Deals 1 more for each Stoneskin you have, up to {n} more.

rows.text: Next Attack panel: 'Your next attack this turn deals {n} more and Pierces.' Pierce panel: glossary sentence.

rows.title: Block / Stoneskin

rows.text: Block panel keeps 'Turn all your Block into Stoneskin.' Stoneskin panel: glossary sentence.

rows.title: Quicken
rows.current: Quicken {n}: Your next card this turn costs {n} less Time (minimum 1).
rows.text: Your next card this turn costs {n} less Time.
rows.grimoire: quicken: a card's Time can't drop below 1.

rows.title: Shock
rows.current: Every enemy this hits is Shocked, including Chain and conducted hits.
rows.text: Every enemy this hits is Shocked.
rows.grimoire: shock: Chain and conducted hits Shock too.

rows.text: Choose an Ice tile within this range and line of sight.

rows.title: Expend
rows.current: Removes the Ice on each pattern tile after the hit. | Removes the Fire beneath each enemy hit after the hit. | Removes the Ice/Fire beneath the target after the hit. | Remove fire beneath you.
rows.text: Removes the Ice on each pattern tile. | Removes the Fire beneath each enemy hit. | Removes the Ice/Fire beneath the target. | Removes the Fire beneath you.
rows.grimoire: surface_consume: the ground is removed after the hit.

rows.title: Light

rows.current: Cleanse panel 'Remove Bleed, Immobilize, Chilled from yourself.' plus Bleed/Immobilize/Chilled panels each repeating 'Cleanse\nRemove ...'
rows.text: One Cleanse panel: 'Remove Bleed, Immobilize and Chilled from yourself.' (list joined with commas and a final 'and'); no panels for the listed statuses (R5).
